# Design Consistency Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the specification, technical plan, and accepted ADRs are complete, mutually consistent, and traceable to each other before task generation — not that any implementation exists or works.
**Created**: 2026-09-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is a documented mapping specified from every URL-shortener functional requirement (FR-SVC-001..012) to a domain-design element in `plan.md`/`data-model.md`? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements — URL Shortener Domain]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is a documented mapping specified from every orchestration functional requirement (FR-ORC-001..020) to a specific node or cross-cutting state in `contracts/orchestration-state-machine.md`? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements — Agentic Orchestration Domain]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is a documented mapping specified from every non-functional requirement (NFR-001..011) to a specific `plan.md` section or accepted ADR? [Completeness, Spec §Non-Functional Requirements]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is a documented mapping specified from every Constitution principle (I–XI) to an entry in `plan.md`'s Constitution Check table? [Completeness, Constitution]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is a documented consumer specified for every accepted ADR's Decision within `plan.md`'s Project Structure or Technical Context (i.e., no ADR whose decision the plan doesn't act on)? [Completeness, Traceability]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Are the specific node identifiers (N1–N14) referenced unambiguously and consistently between `contracts/orchestration-state-machine.md` and the FR-ORC-* requirements they satisfy? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements — Agentic Orchestration Domain]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the boundary between "material" and "cosmetic" artifact revision — which determines whether replanning triggers (FR-ORC-012) — defined with objective criteria rather than left to subjective judgment? [Clarity, ADR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "genuinely parallel/fan-out execution path" (FR-ORC-015) defined precisely enough to distinguish it from sequential execution with concurrent-looking code? [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 - Do the accepted ADRs (docs/adr/ADR-001..014) contain any Decision that contradicts a `plan.md` Constitution Check PASS determination? [Consistency, ADR/Plan cross-check]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the 24-hour human-gate timeout stated consistently across `spec.md` (Confirmed Parameters), `plan.md` (Human-in-the-Loop Controls), and ADR-006? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the "no de-duplication, always mint new code" decision stated consistently across `spec.md` (FR-SVC-001), `data-model.md` (ShortLink), and `contracts/openapi.yaml`? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are the retry-bound defaults (3 attempts, 200ms exponential backoff) stated consistently between `spec.md` (PVT-004), `plan.md` (Reliability Model), and ADR-007? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does the rollback-vs-compensation distinction in `data-model.md`'s `Decision.decision_type` align with the classification behavior described in ADR-008 and User Story 2's negative scenario? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Are the Success Criteria (SC-001..SC-010) each traceable to at least one specific node, cross-cutting state, or user story in the accepted design, such that a reviewer could identify what to inspect? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK015 - Can "genuinely parallel/fan-out" (FR-ORC-015, SC-adjacent) be objectively confirmed from a design artifact alone (e.g., an explicit synchronization-join node), without needing to read implementation code? [Measurability]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the Constitution Check's "PASS" determination for each of the 11 principles backed by a specific, checkable design artifact reference rather than an unsupported assertion? [Measurability, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Does `plan.md`'s Scenario Designs section provide a Greenfield entry with a corresponding `quickstart.md` validation scenario? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK018 - Does `plan.md`'s Scenario Designs section provide a Brownfield entry with a corresponding `quickstart.md` validation scenario? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does `plan.md`'s Scenario Designs section provide an Ambiguous-Requirement entry with a corresponding `quickstart.md` validation scenario? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is at least one node or user story identified that exercises the SAFE_STOP cross-cutting state? [Coverage, `contracts/orchestration-state-machine.md`]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is at least one node or user story identified that exercises the REPLANNING cross-cutting state? [Coverage, `contracts/orchestration-state-machine.md`]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is at least one node or user story identified that exercises the RESUMPTION cross-cutting state? [Coverage, `contracts/orchestration-state-machine.md`]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for what happens when a policy exception's `expires_at` lapses between evaluation cycles, beyond the single invariant already stated in `data-model.md`? [Edge Case, `data-model.md` Cross-Entity Invariants]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for the case where two independent parallel branches (N10/N11/N12) both fail simultaneously — does the design specify which failure is surfaced, or that both are? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for a human providing a clarification answer that is itself ambiguous or incomplete (a second-order ambiguity)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 - Are the proposed validation targets (PVT-001, PVT-002, PVT-003) explicitly marked as unconfirmed/pending approval everywhere they are referenced in `plan.md` and ADRs, rather than silently treated as confirmed in any one location? [Consistency, Spec §Proposed Validation Targets]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the deferred ambiguity AMB-006 (analytics retention after link expiry) explicitly referenced in `plan.md` or `data-model.md`, rather than only existing in `spec.md`? [Traceability, Spec §Ambiguities Deferred]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are the MTTR measurement population, exclusions, and demonstration-data limitations specified with enough precision to be independently recomputed by a reviewer from raw audit data? [Measurability, Plan §Observability and Metrics]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the assumption that "one human operator is available to act at all mandatory gates" (AS-005) reconciled with the 24-hour timeout design (ADR-006) — i.e., does the design account for the operator being unavailable within that window without treating it as an anomaly? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are the dependencies each ADR's Decision introduces (e.g., FastAPI, SQLite, pytest) consistently listed in `plan.md`'s Technical Context "Primary Dependencies" field with no omissions? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 - Is there any requirement or ADR that implies application code or a specific implementation detail beyond the design/architecture level (which `plan.md`'s own rule prohibits at this stage)? [Conflict, Constitution Principle I]
- [ ] CHK032 - Do any two accepted ADRs make decisions that are only reconcilable by an unstated assumption (e.g., ADR-003's SQLite choice and ADR-010's audit-query performance expectations under indefinite retention)? [Conflict, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
